{{Quote|Repeat&hellip; any information on two Human boys riding a dewback&hellip; last seen heading toward Ja-Mero Ridge&hellip; the names of the missing boys are Windom Starkiller&hellip; and Luke Skywalker&hellip;|An announcer|<ref name="Luke Skywalker's Walkabout">{{StoryCite|story=Luke Skywalker's Walkabout|book=Dark Horse Presents Annual 1999: DHP Jr.}}</ref>}}
'''Ja-Mero Ridge''' was a rugged rock formation on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] located near an area of twisted canyons in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi">''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref>

Around [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Windy Starkiller]] attempted a journey to the ridge, but they got held up by a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] and never reached their destination.<ref name="Luke Skywalker's Walkabout" />
